column1: # Words Marathi speakers routinely write in Devanagari but which are NOT
# phonetically derivable from the Marathi phonetic rules: English spelling says
# little about English sound, so "school" would come out स्चूल and "phone"
# फोने. Typed on the Marathi phonetic layout, the English spelling on the left
# resolves directly to the Marathi form on the right, ahead of the rules and of
# the dictionary. Marathi writes the English open o and a with ऑ / ॅ (ऑफिस,
# बॅटरी) and, unlike Hindi, no nukta (फोन, not फ़ोन).
# A hand-written draft that wants a Marathi speaker's review. A wrong entry
# here is worse than a missing one, since it outranks everything.
# Format: english<TAB>marathi   (one mapping per line; # starts a comment)
# Keep the English key lowercase. First column is matched case-insensitively.
